persistent.handlePlace: fixed, centred under the hook at y≈316, the whole reel

scenes.picture: Big abstract phone, close and low; dark scrim over the chat, the input row lit: abstract draft bars and a red send button whose ring fills to 86% and stops.
scenes.keyedTo: ring 0.25–1.5 s; hook move at 2.15 s

scenes.picture: Camera eases to the full phone. Incoming bubble on «رسالة», red outline on «ضايقتك»; the harsh draft typed one whole word at a time on «وكتبت…قاسيًا»; ring again on «وبقيت»; one light shake on «ضغطة». Nothing is sent.
text: أنت آخر من يحق له الكلام

scenes.picture: Same phone. On «اسأل» the draft lifts and a calm blue gap opens between it and the send button (dashed connector). Target icon on «يخدمك», «أم», red spark on «يفرّغ».

The chat screen morphs into a torn paper book scrap (our own card, not the cover): «فكرة من» + title on «كتاب», author on «شين». Below: red dot on «نقع», a red line rushes on «ردود» and stops at a blue gap that appears on «تلقائية»; the gap breathes on «قبل»; a dotted blue path on «أمامنا» to a white decision circle on «قرارًا».

The scrap morphs back into the phone. Blue pause mark over the send button on «وقفة» (button greys). On «اترك» a drafts note appears and the draft moves into it. On «وابتعد» the phone is carried off to the left and a quiet window with a glass of water slides in, cool blue light; the water settles from «ارجع» to «تهدأ», then the phone returns. No timer.

Back on the phone. On «تريد» the draft returns to the field. On «قول» the harsh words are struck and fade one by one; the calm example is typed; on «إهانة» the field and send button turn blue; «مثال» tag. Label on «دون». Button pulses on «حقك», pressed on «تختار», sent on «كيف» as an outgoing bubble; green check on «تردّ».
text: أختلف معك، لكن دعنا نتكلم بهدوء

scenes.picture: Same space: the phone dims behind; a large paper note with a thin green frame rises on «اكتب». The rule appears one whole word at a time on «سأردّ», «عندما», «أهدأ». The save mark fills green on «احفظها». Holds ~1.9 s after the last word.
